## yapmod v0.3.1

This release makes the desktop notifications and the unread badge actually work.

### Fixed

- **Desktop notifications now show up.** The webview cannot post notifications by itself, so yapmod hands them over to the system. Yapin still decides *when* to notify you: muted channels and servers, Do Not Disturb and a window that is in front are all respected.
- **The unread count reaches your app icon.** The number of unread messages now shows on the Dock, on the taskbar and on the panel, where the system supports it.

### New

- Two options in **Settings → Yapin → Yapmod**: *Desktop notifications* and *Show the unread badge*. Both are on by default.
- Clicking a notification brings yapmod to the front and opens the message it was about.

### Install

Download the build for your platform below. macOS builds are ad-hoc signed but not notarized, so right-click **yapmod** and choose **Open** the first time.
